texts.forwarding.codes.no_answer: Forward calls you do not answer.
texts.forwarding.codes.busy: Forward calls while the line is busy.
texts.forwarding.codes.unreachable: Forward calls while the phone is off or out of coverage.
texts.forwarding.steps.1: Take the phone with the SIM card whose number your guests call.
texts.forwarding.steps.2: Dial {no_answer_code} and press call: calls you do not answer go to the assistant at {number}.
texts.forwarding.steps.3: Dial {busy_code} and press call: calls while the line is busy go to the assistant.
texts.forwarding.steps.4: Dial {unreachable_code} and press call: calls while the phone is off or out of coverage go to the assistant.
texts.forwarding.steps.5: After each code wait for the carrier's confirmation on the screen.
texts.forwarding.steps.6: Check it: call your number from another phone and do not answer. The assistant should pick up.
texts.forwarding.notes.1: These are standard GSM codes. Some carriers use other codes or switch forwarding on only in their app or through support; if a code does not work, ask your carrier.
texts.forwarding.notes.2: Forward only unanswered, busy and unreachable calls, never every call: your staff keep answering first.
texts.forwarding.notes.3: Your carrier bills forwarded calls under your own tariff.
texts.forwarding.carriers.ge.magti.note: Magti publishes these codes: *61 no answer, *67 busy, *62 unreachable.
texts.forwarding.carrier_unconfirmed: Standard GSM codes, not yet confirmed with {carrier}: if a code fails, ask {carrier} support.
texts.forwarding.carriers.am.team_telecom.note: Team Telecom Armenia does not charge for switching forwarding on; forwarded calls are billed as outgoing calls. By default it forwards an unanswered call after 30 seconds.
texts.forwarding.carriers.ua.vodafone.note: Vodafone Ukraine also switches each kind of forwarding off on its own: ##61#, ##67# or ##62#.
texts.forwarding.carriers.de.telekom.note: Telekom sends unanswered calls to its mailbox (3311) by default; the no-answer code sends them to the assistant instead.
texts.forwarding.carriers.de.vodafone.note: Vodafone sends unanswered calls to its mailbox (5500) by default; the no-answer code sends them to the assistant instead.
texts.forwarding.carriers.de.o2.note: O2 sends unanswered calls to its mailbox (333) by default; the no-answer code sends them to the assistant instead.
